header: Fifty-eight people, and nobody you will not be able to reach
lead: A surveying and civil-engineering office in Hollerau since 1994. Three offices, one drawing room, and a partner who signs every job.
bodytext:
We measure boundaries, set out roads and drains, monitor structures that move, and hand councils and contractors the drawings they will still be able to open in ten years. Most of our work is within an hour's drive of Hollerau, which is deliberate: a firm that cannot get to a site the same afternoon is a firm that gets there too late.

Everyone below has a direct line and answers it. If you are not sure who to ask, ask Katja Sunder in Hollerau — she has been routing this office's questions since 2003 and is rarely wrong about whose desk they belong on.
